correctness.rationale: The intersection inequality reduces exactly to \(\|x\|^2+\sqrt2\|x\|_\infty\le1/2\), giving vertices \((\pm1/(3\sqrt2),\pm1/(3\sqrt2),\pm1/(3\sqrt2))\) and adjacent distance \(\sqrt2/3\). The three active unit-sphere normals along an edge give \(\cos\alpha=23/27\). Gauss-Bonnet on one congruent spherical face, followed by symmetry, yields \(S=4\pi-20\alpha\). The divergence-theorem/vector-area calculation gives \(V=4\pi/3+2/(3\sqrt2)-49\alpha/6\), while the standard face-curvature plus edge contribution gives the stated Finch-normalized mean width. Fresh numerical evaluation reproduces \(V=0.158029005045087\), \(S=1.540658645708557\), \(W=0.722630772064860\), and an independent spherical radial quadrature gave \(V=0.1580223742\), consistent at the expected grid error.
residual_risks: The formulas are specific to this six-ball octahedral-center intersection.
